purpose: Full-width button row for selectable sidebars, timelines, and master-detail lists with leading, title, description, meta, and trailing regions.
useWhen: Selecting an item in-place from a vertical list, timeline, run list, or master-detail sidebar.
A row must behave like a native button while presenting rich row metadata.

avoidWhen.reason: Navigating to a URL — use stacked-list-item with href or navigation-item instead.
Showing static record rows without button semantics — use stacked-list-item inside data-list.
